_comment: Synthetic signage for KITTI 2011_10_03_drive_0042 at 1 Hz sampling. Frame ids are sequential; source_frame in frames.csv maps back to the KITTI index. The advance bend sign spans 1830-1878 m, inside the 1870 m +-50 window gap-check uses for the curve entering at 2100 m (JKR 230 m placement). Chevrons run through segments 21-24, the sustained left-hand curve.

placements._where: approached between 1830 and 1878 m; grows as the vehicle closes
outside of the curve, one per frame (about 22 m apart) in segments 21-24
